description: You pass iterator ranges to standard algorithms. A lambda is an anonymous function that supplies an operation or condition.

steps.description: The code constructs a vector and sorts it twice. The second sort uses a descending comparison.
find searches for a value. find_if searches for a value that satisfies the lambda's condition.
transform squares each input element into a separate vector.
accumulate combines elements with an initial value. The examples use addition and multiplication.
partition moves elements that satisfy the condition before the returned iterator. Here the condition selects even values.
The final lambda captures running_sum by reference. for_each calls it on each element so it can update that variable.

title: Apply algorithms to iterator ranges
